extracted.intended_audience: credentialed sports media / beat reporters and visiting press covering NBA teams/games
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and operational contact information for credentialed media covering NBA teams and games, including credential pickup, media entrance/parking, will-call, press room contacts, and travel directions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credentials pickup and check-in procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Credentials can be picked up at media table three hours before game time. After being checked in, proceed to the elevator to the sixth floor (John F.X. Condon Press Room).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliverable procedural requirement for media credential pickup: specific pickup location (media table), timing (three hours before game), check-in process and direction to press room. Example: 'Credentials can be picked up at media table three hours before game time. After being checked in, proceed to the elevator to the sixth floor (John F.X. Condon Press Room).' Use this exact timing/location unless otherwise notified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify a dedicated media entrance and where credentials are collected (e.g., 'MEDIA ENTRANCE: Eight Penn Plaza on 33rd Street by the corner of Eighth Avenue').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the precise location of the media entrance and any sign-in/check-in steps so visiting media know where to enter and how to access press facilities. The guide gives street-level landmarks and building entrances for easy navigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking availability and pass issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether media parking is provided and how to obtain it (e.g., 'MEDIA PARKING AREA: None, but there are several pay lots' vs. 'All credentialed media will receive a digital parking pass for Garage 5').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State if no media parking is available (advise pay lots) or if credentialed media receive digital passes for a specified garage/lot. Include where digital passes will be delivered and arrival/route instructions for the parking area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Will Call / Box Office location and access instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Will Call/Ticket Window location and directions from within the arena (e.g., 'The Will Call Ticket Window is located on the northeast side of the building by the Dave Dixon Drive entrance. To get to Will Call from the arena floor, go through the ground tunnel near Section 104 and continue to the arena’s main entrance.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give exact building-side location of Will Call and step-by-step internal directions (tunnels, sections) so media and guests can retrieve credentials/tickets from the arena floor or concourse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed driving directions from major approaches and airports
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide route-by-route driving directions to the venue from nearby highways and airports (examples include directions from Kennedy, LaGuardia, Newark, I-40, I-235, I-35, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include explicit turn-by-turn guidance (exit numbers, parkway names, ramps) and specify landmarks or exit numbers for arriving media. Use separate subsections for northbound/southbound/eastbound/westbound and airport-specific directions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press room and courtside phone/contact numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: List press room office phones and courtside/scorer’s table numbers (e.g., 'Courtside: (212) 465-6139; Scorer’s Table: (212) 465-6537; John F.X. Condon Press Room Office: (212) 465-8893').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide direct phone lines for press room functions (courtside, scorer's table, press office) so media can reach venue staff during game operations. Include fax where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team communications/PR staff contact details
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide names, titles, office and cell phone numbers, and emails for team communications staff (e.g., 'Greg Bensel Sr. Vice President of Communications & Broadcasting O-(504) 593-3759 C-(504) 453-2318 greg.bensel@pelicans.com').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full roster of PR/communications personnel, with multiple phone numbers (office and cell) and direct email addresses for credential requests, interview scheduling, and media relations inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of writers regularly assigned to the club (beat writers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify beat reporters and writers who regularly cover the team with contact info and social handles (e.g., 'WILL GUILLORY, THE ATHLETIC, (504) 442-0089, wguillory@theathletic.com. X: @WillGuillory').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide media accreditation context and facilitate networking by listing local/national beat writers, their outlets, phone numbers, emails and X/Twitter handles where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team broadcasters and network contact listings
rubrics_metrics.description: List team broadcasters, play-by-play announcers, analysts, sideline reporters, producers and their contact information and employer network (e.g., MSG Network, Bally Sports Florida, WWL 870AM/105.3FM, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include radio/TV flagship station contacts, producers, on-air talent and broadcast network production staff so visiting media can coordinate interviews and broadcast logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team website, credential request email, and online media resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide official team media web pages and a credential request email address (e.g., 'Credential Requests E-Mail Address: knickscredentials@msg.com; Media Website: OrlandoMagic.com/magicpr').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the dedicated media/PR webpage, online credential submission address, and any online resources for credentialing and media updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email address formatting conventions for outlets
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the email naming convention used by media outlets/teams (examples: 'KARE E-mail: first initial, last name@kare11.com', 'WCCO Radio E-mail: firstname.lastname@audacy.com', 'WWL E-mail: first initial,lastname@wwltv.com').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State common email formats so reporters can guess or construct addresses when a direct address is not listed; include variations used by specific outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire service and news agency contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Include wire service contact information for Associated Press, Reuters, Bloomberg, etc., with addresses, phone/fax numbers and editor contacts (e.g., 'ASSOCIATED PRESS, 400 South Fourth Street, Suite 504, Minneapolis MN... Sports Editor: Dave Campbell C-(612) 581-7722, dcampbell@ap.org').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide national/international wire service contacts to allow media coordination with news agencies for game-day coverage and photos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue-specific press facilities and phone/fax listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail venue press facilities (press room, training center, will call, box office) and associated phone/fax numbers (e.g., Smoothie King Center Press Room: (504) 593-4919; Fax: (504) 593-4705).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make clear which phone/fax corresponds to which facility and note auxiliary locations (training center address) to support credentialed media’s operational needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions for retrieving will call and navigating from arena floor
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide stepwise directions for media to reach will call from within the arena (e.g., 'To get to Will Call from the arena floor, go through the ground tunnel near Section 104 and continue to the arena’s main entrance').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include internal wayfinding instructions (tunnels, sections) and external access points so media working on the arena floor can quickly obtain tickets/credentials or exit to media areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local station and newsroom contact lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide contact names, phone numbers, emails, and positions for local radio and TV newsrooms, sports directors, assignment desks and producers (examples across multiple markets with station addresses and staff).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List local broadcast news contacts for field coordination, interview booking and logistical support; include newsroom assignment desk phone numbers and general news email addresses.
